design: 12 fixed prompt templates repeated ~83 times (1k run) and ~833 times (10k run); this is repeated-measures sampling, not 1,000/10,000 distinct tasks.
caveat: The archive contains four 10,000-record runs: two with 0 false successes and two with 1, so a per-run zero is not a gated result. The gated aggregate is 30,798 records with 0 false successes and 70,342 unguarded records with 5,696. Because the gate follows case type within a run, the interpretable comparison is at case level (5,495/11,353 ungated vs 0/30,798 gated) and in the matched 10,000-record pair (1,683 vs 0); see manuscript v1.2, sections 4.5 and 5.5.
